name: FSW Television Championship
epitaph: Inaugurated by an eight-man tournament that ran across the promotion's own weekly broadcasts in October and November 2005, with its final scheduled for the promotion's own debut supercard; no result for that final survives in the held record. The title's own belt was confirmed on a reigning champion by the promotion's second supercard in May 2006, defended there in a three-way match against two further challengers; the record does not show when or how that reign began.

name: FSW Sunshine State Championship
epitaph: A second title introduced by early 2006, contested for across the promotion's own broadcasts through mid-2006 and made official as a supercard match by an on-air contract signing; no result for that match survives in the held record.
